title: Postcards and Interior
author: Ulyana Halloran
blurb: Wren Brightwater, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the demolition date arrives.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
